deficiencies.description: The rewrite introduces a causal link by using 'since' to claim that the terminology is still heard today because surgeons can tell by touch, whereas the original text uses 'where' to introduce the clinical context or scenario in which one hears the terminology, without stating a causal relationship.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: And you'll hear this kind of terminology even now, where a surgeon can see just by holding or touching a tumor, whether or not it's movable or immovable.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: This terminology is still heard now, since a surgeon can tell just by holding or touching a tumour whether it is movable or immovable.
deficiencies.studentHarm: A student would learn that the terminology persists specifically because surgeons can detect tumour mobility by touch, rather than understanding that this is simply a context in which the terminology is encountered.
